raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Tsandzile Ndwandwe’s father-in-law was Ngwane III by assuming Sobhuza I’s predecessor (and thus father) was Ngwane III. This conflated regnal numbering/predecessor with immediate paternity and ignored the cited source indicating Sobhuza I’s father is King Ndvungunye (also known as Zikodze), making Ndvungunye the correct father-in-law.
